summaryLines: SIGEIF is a regional public network operated by IZIVIA since January 2024; the owner says one tariff grid applies network-wide.
Verified direct normal 7/22 kW price: 0.39 EUR/kWh on the current Bois-Colombes official IZIVIA station page.
Verified occupancy/parking component on that station: free for 3h, then 0.05 EUR/min; between 20:00 and 08:00 the fee is capped at 4 EUR.
No subscription or dedicated card is required: IZIVIA app, Paynow bank-card ad hoc, or Pass IZIVIA are supported.
Incoming roaming providers are supported; they may set a different retail price, so roaming remains separate.
Rapid 22-50 kW and >50 kW power classes are official, but their exact current tariffs remain unverified in the automated workflow.
